assicurazione.titolo: Health insurance for your visa application
assicurazione.testo: Most of these visas require private health insurance valid in the country: check the cover the consulate asks for before you buy.

cambio.testo: Multi-currency account to receive income and pay in euros at the real exchange rate.

avvocato.testo: Independent lawyers can review your documents before you apply.
